lines.en: I can't believe this is happening.
- Afro-wig? Do you want the Afro-wig?
- No. Michael, I'm not leaving the car.
- Here's how it's gonna go down.
You and I are gonna sneak inside,
and we pretend that we are warehouse workers,
and we will silly string the bejesus out of the place.
- And if we have to defend ourselves,
I will stab the security guard in the eye
- No. No, you won't do that.
- Nope. - Then I'll grind up the jumbo chalk
and blow it in his eyes.
- Dwight, nothing with the eyes. Please?
That's her. Go. Go, go, go, go.
- Move, move, move, move, move, move, move, move, move, move, move.
- This is the dumbest thing we've ever done.
You really don't need to be updating me
as much as you're updating me.
It's a security guard coming by.
I can see the security guard's eyes.
- I have to do something to his eyes.
- The eyes are the groin of the head.
If you found that choking hazard poster,
Their crown jewel, their industrial copier.
- It's enormous, but it's got wheels.
We're wheeling it down the hall into the stairwell.
- No, that is a terrible idea.
- We're waiting between the copier and the railing.
- Okay, first of all, stop using my name.
- Strike, move over a little bit.
- I don't have the control of my bladder.
- Just say you want to get back together.
- It doesn't have to mean anything.
Just climb on top of her and think about Stanley.
If this is it for me, promise me something.
- Uh, what are you doing here?
I'm just checking on the other branches.
Michael wants me to do that from time to time, so--
- Do not tell Karen about the industrial copier.
- I cried for weeks over that guy, so yeah.
Seeing him climb out of a PT Cruiser
in a ladies' warehouse uniform felt pretty good.
- I'm not sure what you're doing here.
